basic_profile.bio: New to Reddit and still figuring out the ropes. I'm a TV enthusiast with a soft spot for crime dramas and historical series. I work as a graphic designer in Franklin, TN, and enjoy dabbling in retro gaming on weekends. I'm single, living with my two cats, and love exploring new TV shows during late-night binge sessions. My online activity peaks after 9 PM when I wind down with some screen time.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: As a graphic designer, I've honed my skills through a mix of formal education and self-teaching. My interest in crime dramas stems from a lifelong fascination with storytelling and visual arts. I've recently started exploring socialist themes in gaming and have a budding curiosity about remote viewing techniques.
